title: Grateful Dead Live at Great Western Forum on 1989-12-10
lineage: Sony TC-D5M master deck and master cassette, no n.r. -> Tascam DVRA1000 DSD recorder in pcm mode, 24/96
source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's HRTF -> Sony TC-D5M. Mics at 6'5". Also covering an ortf pair of Neumann km84's -> Sony TC-D5M rig, on a stand.

ai_review.summary: Excellent performance highlighted by a stellar I Know You Rider and an epic Jerry‑Bob post‑show interview; recording quality isn’t discussed but is presumed solid.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the concert, calling it “wicked” and praising the rendition of I Know You Rider. The only technical comment is a mention of a memorable Jerry‑Bob interview after the show, with no complaints about sound quality, suggesting the recording is at least listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and focus on strong musical moments; lack of recording details prevents a higher confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments about soundboard, audience mix, or audio clarity; reviewers’ enthusiasm implies the recording is acceptable.
